[[Dorn Base]] was supplied by a '''power station''' nearby on the [[Bitewind Plain]] in the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commandos took over the power station and attempted to destroy it.
